title: Pick a card: your role at the next family gathering
caption:
Pause. Pick 1, 2, 3 or 4. Then swipe to find your role at the next family gathering.

No predictions here: each card is just a small job worth doing, whether it's a wedding, a birthday or a holiday dinner.

Comment your number and tag the relative who'd get card 2.
